postToolUse.powershell: $hookData = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $editTools = @('edit_file', 'create_file', 'replace_string_in_file', 'multi_replace_string_in_file'); if ($hookData.toolName -in $editTools) { Write-Host '[hook] File changed — running vp check...'; vp check }
postToolUse.comment: Run vp check after each file edit to surface type/lint errors early so they can be fixed in the same session

sessionEnd.powershell: $hookData = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($hookData.reason -eq 'complete') { Write-Host '[hook] Session complete — running quality gates...'; vp check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { vpr test --run } }
sessionEnd.comment: Run full quality gate (vp check + vpr test --run) at session end to confirm CI is green
